name: trade-automatizado-openclaw
description: Skill OpenClaw para setups delta-neutros e ordens solo em DEX/CEX configuráveis, com wizard por corretora, sem venue nem modo padrão (o operador escolhe), CEX genérica via CCXT, Hyperliquid DEX builtin, stop por alvo configuravel e DEX custom por adapter Python, margin sizing, guardrails, bootstrap seguro e dashboard HTML local do usuário.
author: CodeLab-IntusHub

dependencies.python_optional_note: Exigido apenas por DEX_ID=nado; instale com `pip install -r workspace/requirements-nado.txt` (requer toolchain de build nativo). As demais venues rodam por ccxt.

commands.name: setup-check
commands.description: Verifica runtime, paths, dependências e envs sem inicializar exchanges

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Roda checklist operacional OpenClaw

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.description: Cria/atualiza .venv local e instala requirements

commands.name: venues
commands.description: Mostra DEX/CEX selecionadas, adapters e envs esperadas

commands.name: symbols
commands.description: Lista símbolos comuns entre a DEX e a CEX selecionadas

commands.name: asset-scan
commands.description: Compara ativos/perps da DEX e CEX selecionadas e detecta adicionados/removidos, preço inválido e spread alto

commands.name: setups
commands.description: Lista os setups operacionais disponíveis

commands.name: backtest-operational
commands.description: Roda validação operacional dos setups monitorados

commands.name: backtest-divergence-volume-real
commands.description: Valida o setup Divergence and Volume com candles reais 4h via CCXT

commands.name: backtest-low-stoch-real

commands.name: backtest-funding-real
commands.description: Valida o setup Funding Arb com historico real de funding

commands.name: calibrate-triangle-real
commands.description: Calibra thresholds reais do Triangle Breakout

commands.name: calibrate-funding-real
commands.description: Calibra thresholds reais do Funding Arb

commands.name: setup-live-status

commands.name: dashboard

commands.name: dashboard-publisher

commands.name: close-venue-pair

commands.name: status
commands.description: Mostra delta, drift e PnL

commands.name: live-status
commands.description: Mostra posições live detectadas nas duas exchanges

commands.name: live-hedge
commands.description: Hedgeia exposição live detectada

commands.name: live-sync
commands.description: Monitora e replica abertura manual entre exchanges

commands.name: rebalance

commands.name: unwind
commands.description: Fecha ambas as pernas ou a perna solo salva em state.json

commands.name: farm
commands.description: Loop: rebalance periódico + stop global

commands.name: opportunistic

commands.name: funding
commands.description: Mostra funding rates

commands.name: cex-accounts
commands.description: Alias genérico para mostrar contas/saldos da CEX selecionada

commands.name: kraken-accounts

commands.name: simulate

commands.name: scenario-matrix
commands.description: Mostra a matriz completa de cenarios por ativo/setup

wizard.account_isolation_policy: subconta/vault/conta isolada sao recomendados quando a corretora/DEX oferecer esse recurso, mas opcionais por padrao; a decisao final e do usuario e nao deve ser hard-coded; se nao usar esse modelo, exija no minimo API key/credencial dedicada sem saque e valide doctor/dry-run
wizard.release_note: v1.2.0 roda em Windows (lock cross-platform no lugar de fcntl) e torna o SDK da Nado uma dependencia opcional por venue: quem opera Hyperliquid/CEX instala apenas requirements.txt.
wizard.activation_policy: bare skill name, configurar, refazer wizard, or unconfigured skill must start first_run_setup.py --json before venues/setup-check/doctor
wizard.other_integrations_notice: Outras CEXs podem usar CEX_ID=<exchange_id CCXT>; Hyperliquid usa adapter builtin; outras DEXs exigem DEX_ADAPTER_MODULE antes de live.
